s.n: Cairo market hummus and baba ganoush
s.note: Chickpea hummus and smoky eggplant dip, flatbread, dukkah, olives, cucumber.
s.how: Blitz a drained tin of chickpeas with 3 tbsp tahini, lemon, garlic and iced water until silky. Char an eggplant over a flame, scoop and mash with tahini and lemon. Serve with warm flatbreads, dukkah, olives, cucumber, paprika and olive oil.

m.n: Mena Camp mutton and barley stew
m.note: Lamb shoulder, pearl barley and carrots from the dixie.
m.how: Brown 1kg diced lamb shoulder in 2 tbsp oil. Add 2 chopped onions, 3 sliced carrots and 2 crushed garlic cloves and soften. Add 150g rinsed pearl barley, 1.25l beef stock, 2 bay leaves and 4 thyme sprigs, then cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours until the lamb is tender and the barley soft. Season well and serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Little shortcrust tarts filled with plum and apple jam, the tin every digger got sick of.
w.how: Heat the oven to 190C. Cut 2 sheets of shortcrust pastry into 12 rounds and press into a patty tin. Fill each with a heaped teaspoon of plum and apple jam (about 250g in all). Bake 15 minutes until the pastry is golden. Cool in the tin, then dust with icing sugar.

w.note: Crisp oat and coconut biscuits sweetened with golden syrup.
w.how: Mix 90g oats, 150g flour, 85g coconut and 150g brown sugar. Melt 125g butter with 2 tbsp golden syrup, then add 1 tsp bicarb dissolved in 2 tbsp boiling water. Stir together, roll into balls, flatten and bake at 160C for 15 minutes.

d.note: Hot black tea with fresh mint and sugar, poured high the hawkers' way.
d.how: Steep 4 black tea bags and most of a bunch of mint in 1 litre of boiling water for 4 minutes. Remove the tea bags, stir in 4 tbsp sugar and pour into glasses with a mint sprig in each.
